proposal.hypothesis: Changing only the row-loop schedule from contiguous static assignment to cyclic one-row static chunks may alter locality for shared B and output rows. Since each row has uniform work, this tests whether interleaving helps or hurts while preserving the parent’s thread cap, small-size serial path, and r-c-k accumulation order; no speedup is assumed.

retained: Change the outer row loop from default static scheduling to schedule(static, 1), assigning rows cyclically in one-row chunks.
Keep the existing per-call thread cap, serial path for sizes below 128, disjoint row ownership, and r-c-k computation unchanged.
